params.name: hostname
params.description: Fully-qualified domain name (or IP) used as the AtScale ingress domain and as the certificate Common Name / SAN when generating a self-signed cert

params.name: cert-file
params.description: Path to an existing PEM-encoded TLS certificate file. If omitted a self-signed certificate is generated automatically.

params.name: key-file
params.description: Path to an existing PEM-encoded private key file. Required when --cert-file is provided.

params.name: license-key
params.description: AtScale license key to embed in the values.yaml. Written to atscale-entitlement.entitlement.licenseKey. If omitted the field is left blank and the key can be uploaded via the UI after install.

params.name: output-file
params.description: Output file path for the generated values.yaml

params.name: enable-mcp
params.description: Enable the AtScale MCP server sub-chart (atscale-mcp.enabled). Accepts true/false, yes/no, 1/0, on/off, or standalone flag. Defaults to false.

params.name: minimal
params.description: Emit additional Helm values that reduce the hardware footprint: disables telemetry, removes the Redis replica, and shrinks default PVC sizes.

params.name: external-postgres
params.description: Emit Helm values that point AtScale at an externally-managed PostgreSQL instance instead of the bundled `db` sub-chart: disables the in-cluster database and wires each service's externalDatabase block to Kubernetes secrets. The connection credentials (host/port/user/password) are NOT taken as inputs — stubbed secret manifests are emitted as a header comment for the operator to fill in and apply. Keycloak is pinned to a dedicated `keycloak` Postgres schema (KC_DB_SCHEMA) rather than `public`; the operator must create that schema before install (a CREATE SCHEMA statement is included in the emitted header comment). Verified against AtScale Helm chart 2026.5.0.

params.name: gatekeeper-compliant
params.description: Emit Helm values that satisfy common OPA Gatekeeper constraints: sets image.pullPolicy=Always and serviceAccount.create=true per subchart, and resource requests/limits via global.resourcesPreset (poc when combined with --minimal, otherwise prod). Some constraints cannot be met via values.yaml and require a namespace exemption; these are listed in a comment in the output. Verified against AtScale Helm chart 2026.5.0.

params.description: Database (catalog) name to read tables from

params.name: schema
params.description: Schema name to read tables from

params.name: tables
params.description: Comma-separated table names or wildcard patterns to include (e.g. "Dim*,FactSales"). Omit to extract all tables.

params.name: output-file
params.description: Output file path for the generated DDL. Omit to print to stdout.

params.name: insecure
params.description: Skip TLS certificate verification (overrides the connections file value). Defaults to true.

extract-data-shape-from-connection.description: Connect to a database and extract a statistical fingerprint of the SML model data shape

params.name: connection-file
params.description: Path to the connections.yaml file (default: connections.yaml)

params.name: connection-name
params.description: Name of the connection entry in the connections.yaml file

params.name: sml-path
params.description: Path to the SML output directory or a model.yml file produced by generate-sml-from-connection / generate-sml-from-ddl

params.name: output-file
params.description: Output path for the fingerprint YAML (default: data-shape.yaml)

params.name: target-fact-rows
params.description: Target row count when sampling large fact tables for density profiling (default: 100000; 0 = no sampling)

params.name: target-column-rows
params.description: Target row count for measure column distribution sampling (default: 10000; 0 = no sampling)

params.name: tablesample
params.description: Use TABLESAMPLE SYSTEM for fact sampling when true (default: true). Set to false for databases that do not support TABLESAMPLE (e.g. MySQL).

params.name: serial
params.description: Profile dimensions one at a time instead of in parallel (default: false). Use when the database enforces a low per-user connection limit.

params.name: preserve-meta-data
params.description: Store original table and column names in the fingerprint so data generation uses real names instead of synthetic ones (default: false)

generate-ddl-from-data-shape.description: Generate CREATE TABLE DDL from a data-shape.yaml statistical fingerprint

params.name: input-file
params.description: Path to the data-shape.yaml fingerprint file (default: data-shape.yaml)

params.name: output-file
params.description: Output path for the generated DDL.  Omit to write to stdout.

params.name: dialect
params.description: SQL dialect: ansi (default), postgresql, snowflake, mysql, bigquery

params.name: preserve-meta-data
params.description: Use original table and column names from the fingerprint metadata block instead of synthetic names (default: false). Only has effect when the fingerprint was extracted with --preserve-meta-data true.

generate-data-from-data-shape.description: Generate synthetic CSV data from a data-shape.yaml statistical fingerprint

params.name: input-file
params.description: Path to the data-shape.yaml fingerprint file (default: data-shape.yaml)

params.name: output-dir
params.description: Directory where CSV files are written (default: data)

params.name: scale-factor
params.description: Scale row/member counts by this factor (default: 1.0; use < 1 for smaller datasets)

params.name: seed
params.description: Random seed for reproducible output (omit for non-deterministic)

params.name: reports-dir
params.description: Directory where security reports are written (default: <output-dir>/_reports)

params.name: preserve-meta-data
params.description: Use original table and column names from the fingerprint metadata block instead of synthetic names (default: false). Only has effect when the fingerprint was extracted with --preserve-meta-data true.

generate-data-from-data-shape-to-connect.description: Generate synthetic data from a fingerprint and load it into a live database

params.name: input-file
params.description: Path to the data-shape.yaml fingerprint file (default: data-shape.yaml)

params.name: connection-file
params.description: Path to the connections.yaml file (default: connections.yaml)

params.name: connection-name
params.description: Name of the connection entry in the connections file

params.name: scale-factor
params.description: Scale row/member counts by this factor (default: 1.0)

params.name: seed
params.description: Random seed for reproducible output

params.name: create-tables
params.description: Emit CREATE TABLE statements before inserting (default: false)

params.name: drop-if-exists
params.description: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS before creating tables — implies --create-tables (default: false)

params.name: dialect
params.description: SQL dialect for CREATE TABLE: ansi, postgresql, snowflake, mysql, bigquery. When omitted, the dialect is read from the connection configuration (sql.dialect); falls back to ansi.

params.name: batch-size
params.description: Rows per INSERT statement (default: 500)

params.name: schema
params.description: Target schema to qualify table names (e.g. PUBLIC).  Omit to use the connection default.

params.name: reports-dir
params.description: Directory where security reports are written (default: ./_reports)

params.name: preserve-meta-data
params.description: Use original table and column names from the fingerprint metadata block instead of synthetic names (default: false). Only has effect when the fingerprint was extracted with --preserve-meta-data true.

generate-enhanced-query-results.description: Enrich a execute-atscale-query-harness results CSV with the AtScale query_id, outbound SQL text, and optionally the execution plan from the target data source (requires --target-connection-name)

params.name: results-file
params.description: Path to the run-results CSV produced by execute-atscale-query-harness

params.name: connection-file
params.description: Path to connections.yaml

params.name: connection-name
params.description: Connection name within connections.yaml. The metadata: block is used when present; falls back to the sql: block.

params.name: output-file
params.description: Output path for the enhanced CSV. Defaults to {results-file-stem}_enhanced.csv in the same directory.

params.name: db-schema
params.description: Postgres schema prefix for the AtScale backend tables (e.g. 'engine' or 'atscale'). Auto-detected from the connection file when omitted (installer → 'atscale', container → 'engine').

params.name: days
params.description: How far back in the AtScale query log to search (default: 7). Increase if the harness run was more than a week ago.

params.name: target-connection-name
params.description: Connection name within connections.yaml for the target data source. When provided, the operation connects to the target database and fetches an execution plan (EXPLAIN) for each outbound query, stored in the 'execution_plan' column. Supported dialects: snowflake, postgres, redshift.

execute-run-analysis.description: Compare two execute-atscale-query-harness run logs (or enhanced outputs) query-by-query; writes a plain-text summary report, a full row-by-row comparison CSV, and a filtered outliers CSV for row-count and duration mismatches

params.name: file-a
params.description: Path to the first run log (execute-atscale-query-harness CSV) or enhanced output (generate-enhanced-query-results CSV)

params.name: file-b
params.description: Path to the second run log or enhanced output to compare against file-a

params.name: join-key
params.description: Column to join queries across the two files. Use 'original_text_hash' (default) to match queries by SQL text, or 'original_atscale_query_id' to match by the AtScale query ID recorded at capture time.

params.name: duration-variance-pct
params.description: Percentage threshold for flagging duration differences. A pair is flagged when |(b_duration - a_duration) / a_duration| × 100 exceeds this value. Default: 20.

params.name: summary-file
params.description: Path to write the plain-text summary report

params.name: comparison-file
params.description: Path to write the row-by-row comparison CSV

params.name: outliers-file
params.description: Path to write the outliers CSV — a filtered subset of --comparison-file containing only pairs flagged for a row-count mismatch or a duration outside the variance threshold

generate-queries-from-sml.description: Read an SML directory and generate XMLA and SQL query JSON files covering every metric (grand-total) and every hierarchy level (per-level breakdown), compatible with execute-atscale-query-harness

params.name: sml-dir
params.description: Path to the SML directory (must contain models/, metrics/, dimensions/ sub-directories)

params.name: model-name
params.description: Model label or unique_name to use (defaults to the first model found)

params.name: cube-name
params.description: Override the cube name used in MDX FROM and SQL FROM clauses. Defaults to the model label from the SML model file.

params.name: xmla-output-file
params.description: Path to write the XMLA (MDX) query JSON file

params.name: sql-output-file
params.description: Path to write the SQL query JSON file

generate-queries-from-model.description: Read a model.yaml file and generate XMLA and SQL query JSON files covering every metric (grand-total) and every hierarchy level (per-level breakdown), compatible with execute-atscale-query-harness

params.name: model-file
params.description: Path to the model.yaml file (output of extract-model-from-atscale or extract-model-from-sml)

params.name: model-name
params.description: Top-level model key to use when model.yaml contains multiple models. Defaults to the first model found.

params.name: cube-name
params.description: Override the cube name used in MDX FROM and SQL FROM clauses. Defaults to the model name (top-level key).

params.name: xmla-output-file
params.description: Path to write the XMLA (MDX) query JSON file

params.name: sql-output-file
params.description: Path to write the SQL query JSON file

get-dso-count.description: Get the DSO count from models

params.name: connection-file
params.description: File that defines all the connections

params.name: connection-name
params.description: The name of the connection in the connection file

params.name: catalog
params.description: The name of the catalog to pull the DSO count for. Ignore to pull all catalogs

params.name: model
params.description: The name of the model to pull the DSO count for. Ignore to pull all models

execute-web-services.description: Start a GraphQL HTTP server that exposes all operations as mutations

params.name: port
params.description: Port the GraphQL server will listen on

params.name: host
params.description: Host / bind address for the server
